C0643.title: Legal Risk Analysis of Add-on Purchases and Refunds
C0643.summary: Media reports, court cases, and lawyer commentary indicate that order-combining followed by refunds is not necessarily illegal, but frequent use of this pattern to obtain discounts can create civil or criminal risk. It is necessary to distinguish normal no-reason returns, malicious repeated extraction of full-reduction discounts, and fictitious transactions used to defraud platform subsidies, rather than treating ordinary return disputes as fraud crimes.
